Name: Clear enemy bullets
Description: Remove the current enemy bullets from the native ENEMY_SHOT pool. Lasers and other projectile types remain. Enemies can fire again on later frames, and existing impact effects may finish naturally.
RestoreBehavior: Applied once in a running Gummi mission. Removed bullets are not restored when the trainer disconnects. This action does not award absorption points or directly change saves.

Evidence.Finding: The original bulk clear deactivates the 768-entry ENEMY_SHOT pool and clears each active main sprite. The current scheduler task, record classes, permanent sprite indices and nondeleting ownership flags are verified before one native dispatch.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly and isolated fake-memory/callout tests. No live Gummi validation.

Name: Active enemy-bullet records
Description: Count active ENEMY_SHOT pool entries. This includes entries in their impact or final phase, so it can differ from the number of visible flying bullets. Other projectile classes are excluded.
RestoreBehavior: Read-only. Shown only while the current Gummi module, owner task and complete pool can be validated; a paused mission can still be read.

Evidence.Finding: The native initializer creates 768 records of 176 bytes. Flag bit0x100 marks active entries, including the impact state until native retirement.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly and isolated fake-memory tests. No live Gummi validation.
